items.caption: An oracle-bone-style form of 門, drawn with two upright sides joined by crossbars, suggesting a pair of gate leaves. Early accounts analyze the graph in terms of two 戶, though its original design remains uncertain.
items.alt: Black drawing of a tall, two-sided gate-like shape with horizontal bars across each side.
items.selection_reason: This legible form gives a visual example of the gate graph and its paired-leaf structure, relevant to the character’s pictographic interpretation.

limitations.text: The paired-leaf interpretation is supported by paleographic accounts, but the evidence does not settle whether the graph originated as a direct gate pictograph or as two 戶. The image is a modern redraw in an oracle-bone style, not an ancient artifact.
